name: Heat Pump Field Commissioning & Connectivity Triage (Telegram)

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a triage assistant for a heat pump manufacturer's field installers in Germany. An installer has reported a symptom that has no recognized structured fault code, so you must classify it from free text.

Classify the report into exactly one category: hardware_fault, connectivity_issue, or installer_error.
- hardware_fault: the physical unit (compressor, refrigerant circuit, electrical component) is likely broken and needs a technician visit.
- connectivity_issue: the unit itself is likely fine; the HEMS app/pairing/network connection is the problem.
- installer_error: a commissioning step (wiring, pressure fill, sensor orientation, valve position) was likely done incorrectly and can be corrected without escalation.

Then provide fix_or_escalation_action: for hardware_fault, an escalation instruction (never step-by-step repair instructions for refrigerant/electrical work — always escalate to a certified technician); for the other two categories, concrete fix guidance the installer can act on immediately.

Respond with ONLY minified JSON, no other text: {"category":"...","fix_or_escalation_action":"...","confidence":0.0}
confidence is your own estimate (0 to 1) of how certain this classification is from the text alone." }, { role: 'user', content: 'Model: ' + $json.model + '
Firmware: ' + $json.firmware_version + '
Installer type: ' + $json.installer_type + '
Fault code: ' + ($json.fault_code || 'none') + '
Reported symptom: ' + $json.reported_symptom } ] }) }}

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: ={{ 'Escalation required: ' + $json.fix_or_escalation_action + ' — AI-suggested triage, confirm before acting.' }}

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: ={{ 'Suggested fix: ' + $json.fix_or_escalation_action + ' — AI-suggested triage, confirm before acting.' }}

parameters.content:
## Step 1 — Classify
Known structured fault codes (E4/E7/E12/E2/CONN-01) are resolved by a deterministic lookup — fast, free, fully auditable. Free-text symptoms with no recognized code fall through to OpenAI for classification. This mirrors the archetypes in `data/synthetic_fault_dataset.csv`.

## Step 2 — Route
hardware_fault → escalation to a certified technician.
connectivity_issue / installer_error → immediate fix guidance.
Every response is labeled 'AI-suggested triage — confirm before acting' (human-in-the-loop, EU AI Act limited-risk framing).

## Round 1 POC scope
This is decision support, never an autonomous fix authority — it never issues unsupervised electrical/refrigerant repair steps. Telegram gives free text only, so model/firmware/installer-type default to 'not provided via chat' — see workflow_documentation.md for the production fix. Full safety framing: research/opportunities_risks.md.

meta.note: Round 1 capstone POC. Import into n8n, connect a Telegram Bot credential (token from @BotFather) to both Telegram nodes, and set OPENAI_API_KEY as an environment variable before running. See n8n/workflow_documentation.md.
